notes.title: Continuing Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Our team is still hard at work with providing bug fixes that will improve the user experience for everyone. It has come to our attention that there are multiple bugs in our game, and some of the more major bugs include the Shop and the Tutorial. We will continue working on fixing both, but while there are still issues found in Tutorial and Shop, we will be removing Shop and Tutorial from the game. Let us know if you have any feedback or requests on fixes but leaving something in the comments or emailing us at stickdodgevr@gmail.com.
From,
TheStickDodgeVR Team

notes.title: New Updates
notes.content:
We have been hard at work to post working updates and fix any bugs that there have been since launch. Since the last announcement, we have also added more game modes that should make the game more fun to play! We have added timed mode, insanely hard mode, last life mode and we still have classic mode! Not only have more modes been added, but there has also been the addition of 2 new levels and bug fixes! The bug fixes are major and they allow the game to be smoother and play better! If there are still any bugs that need to be fixed, please leave something on the discussion board and we will try to address the fix immediately. If you have any recommendations, please let us know.
Thanks,
The StickDodgeVR Team

notes.title: Update 1.04
notes.content: In this most recent update we have fixed a bunch of helpful issues with more bug updates to come. We have fixed the timing of the enemy throw, some UI problems and also the major fix with Target Practice not working.  We also plan on adding a discount this coming weekend and also we plan on adding some more updated footage of the scenery and fixes.

notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.content:
In this minor update, it was just a quick improvement on the UI with a minor bug. We have also decreased the chance to get a coin thrown at you from 20% to 10%. Another improvement that we have added from a result of multiple requests is to make the balls bounce when thrown. So we are happy to say that the dodge balls now bounce when they hit the ground. In the next update we plan making some major improvements on the enemy AI! If you have any questions, comments, or suggestions, please contact us in the online forums or through our email, StickDodgeVR@gmail.com.
Thanks,
The StickDodgeVR Team

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.content: In this most recent update, we have changed the scenery in the game scene to make it look more the player is in a jail cell while playing. We are going to continue to test this out and get user feedback from our Kickstarter and Indiegogo backers. We have also continued to fix some minor bugs and improvements.
